name: @pinelab/vendure-plugin-content-automation
description: Vendure plugin that generates and checks entity content per channel and language: bulk content automation via consumer-provided strategies, and storefront/catalog content health checks (meta tags, hreflang, JSON-LD, sitemap inclusion) shown in the dashboard. Both features are optional.
author: Surafel Tariku <surafelmelese09@gmail.com>

scripts.build: rimraf dist && tsc && copyfiles -u 1 'src/dashboard/**/*' dist/ && yarn build:dashboard
